title: Reading other AWS accounts' SQL on Amazon Athena
summary: Cross-tenant flaw in Amazon Athena let an undocumented Catalog=system parameter on StartQueryExecution read other AWS accounts' full SQL text and account IDs from Trino's runtime.queries table; AWS fixed it globally in 4 days (no customer action needed).

title: So… You Found AWS Access Keys (Part 1)
summary: Practical breakdown of AWS access-key types, where they turn up during engagements, and how to validate and use them once found.

title: Prowler 5.42.0
summary: Prowler 5.42.0 adds AWS ISO-partition scanning, configurable connect/read timeouts for restricted-egress networks, reusable Trivy vulnerability-database caching for image scans, and fixes duplicate/stale compliance-check references across 42 frameworks.

title: AWS Security Reference Architecture: A deep dive into PCI DSS compliance
summary: AWS extends the AWS Security Reference Architecture with a PCI DSS deep dive mapping SRA account-scoping and service-configuration patterns to PCI DSS requirements (account/CDE scoping, encryption, logging, access control) for organizations building or assessing a PCI-scoped multi-account landing zone.

title: Operationalizing least privilege: Automate IAM remediation through your CI/CD pipeline
summary: Automated workflow classifies IAM Access Analyzer findings by role provenance and produces a CDK pull request, an issue with migration guidance, or a monitored decommission plan, turning unused-permission detection into durable remediation that survives the next IaC deployment.

title: AWS STS simplifies session token size limits and adds session token size monitoring
summary: AWS STS replaces separate packed-policy and overall-token size limits with a single 4,096-byte session token limit, and now exposes session token size in API responses/CloudTrail/CloudWatch plus a new MinimumSessionTokenSize testing parameter.

title: The Danger of Multi-SSO AWS Cognito User Pools
summary: In multi-tenant Cognito User Pools with multiple registered external IdPs, gaps in Lambda trigger execution ordering (only TokenGeneration is shared between first federated sign-in and later sign-ins) let a malicious or compromised external IdP bypass identity constraints enforced in only one of the two auth chains.

title: Navigating Lax Load Balancers: When an Intersection Gets You Inside
summary: Catalogs recurring ALB/ELB routing misconfigurations - direct-to-origin CloudFront/WAF bypass, listener rule shadowing, and target groups reachable outside the intended entry point - that static config review misses because it doesn't trace the actual reachable routing graph.
